name: Sprint 3 candidate — iteration 02
description: Exploratory breakpoint and mobile-recovery pass. Bruiser retains Rush/Berserk burst but loses effortless attrition; Rogue gains distinct tempo and recovery roles. Not yet the live default.

nightwalker_ambush.rulesText: Response: deal 4 damage to the attacker before combat.

nightwalker_strike.rulesText: Deal 5 damage to one enemy battlefield card.

rogue_commander.rulesText: Unique. Command — other allies here gain +1 Attack. Mobile. Medic — heal each ally here by 1 at your turn start.
